How a waterless urinal works

Gravity handles drainage. The odour trap and regular care support day-to-day use.

01 · Drain by gravity

Urine leaves the bowl through the drainage connection. Existing pipework still needs assessment; removing a flush does not correct a drainage defect.

02 · Control odour

The MB Active odour trap is part of the system. Use the correct component and follow the current manufacturer’s instructions for installation and replacement.

03 · Keep a care routine

Train cleaning staff, use compatible products and record inspections. Persistent odour or slow drainage calls for investigation rather than improvised chemicals.
